name: 92201 · Indio, CA
findings: ZIP 92201 (Indio) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92201 (Indio) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
